items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Grasping Hands T2, Borrowed Decree T2.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 16 to Grasping Hands's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 6,400 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 6400 souls (~6.4 min), 5 purchases

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 28.8 to Grasping Hands's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Borrowed Decree: its duration-scaled parts (duration 16s, channel time 0.7s) get +22%.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases
items.legacy_note: Sell it for Refresher if you get rich.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-24,800 (levels 12-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Grasping Hands T3, Borrowed Decree T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Grasping Hands, damage) grows from 259 to 413. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Lifesteal, spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Temporary, sold when you buy Magic Carpet later.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Diviner's Kevlar, 16000 souls (~16.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Borrowed Decree: takes 18% off its 125s base cooldown.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Borrowed Decree duration (26s), Borrowed Decree summon lifetime (20s), Borrowed Decree slow duration (1.2s). Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. | With 2 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 145s; 20% off is 29s per full rotation.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Borrowed Decree gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (125s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 5,600 to 12,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 24,800-30,400 (levels 28-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Jar of Dead T3.

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.caption: +20 spirit adds about 32 to Grasping Hands's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.legacy_note: Dash-jump right before you cast your ult.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 48 to Grasping Hands's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 30,400-54,400 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Essence Theft T3.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.why: contradiction: Echo Shard resets non-ultimate abilities only and Borrowed Decree is the ultimate.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Magic Carpet
items.caption: +14 spirit adds about 22.4 to Grasping Hands's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 27,200 to 33,600 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Spirit Lifesteal: sell it when you buy this.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Heroic Aura? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Arcane Surge.
sections.desc: Dying after Heroic Aura? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Arcane Surge.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you. Pop it and keep casting.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows, hexes and burns like Infernus's.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep stopping you casting your ult.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Replaces Arcane Surge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Arcane Surge for this, or Heroic Aura if it's gone.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 145s of base cooldown across your kit, 125s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Enchanter's Emblem: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Use it right after Echo Shard for a third gravestone. Sell Enchanter's Emblem for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
